lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Operator? Can you hear me?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Your biometric readings are unstable. Please respond.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: What the hell happened?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: A Fracture event has occurred approximately 1.8 kilometres from your current position.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: A what?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I am detecting an anomalous energy signature across the entire city.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: People are still inside those buildings!

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Correct. Approximately 340 civilians remain inside the immediate danger zone.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then we're getting them out.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: That decision is statistically dangerous.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Get used to it.

lines.speaker: BOY
lines.text: Please! Somebody help my dad!

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Hey. Look at me. What's your name?

lines.speaker: BOY
lines.text: Daniel.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Daniel, I'm going to get your dad out. Stay right here.

lines.speaker: MAN
lines.text: Don't... don't worry about me. Get my son somewhere safe.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I'm getting both of you out.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Operator, movement detected beneath the overturned vehicle.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: What kind of movement?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Unknown biological signatures.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Daniel! Get behind me!

lines.speaker: DANIEL
lines.text: What was that thing?

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I don't know.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I have identified the biological structure.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I cannot classify it.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: And I am detecting hundreds more.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Stop right there! Identify yourself!

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I'm not your enemy.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: That's what everyone says until one of those things starts wearing their face.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I've been helping civilians get out.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: You survived the initial event?

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Apparently.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Then you're either incredibly lucky or something happened to you.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Operator, this individual has access to military command networks.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Can you identify him?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Commander Elias Voss. Frontier Defense Initiative.

lines.speaker: MILITARY RADIO
lines.text: Command, this is Outpost Seven! We're under attack! Repeat, we're under attack!

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Everyone, defensive positions! Move!

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: You wanted to help? Here's your chance.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: What the hell are those things?

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: You tell me. You're the military.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: We've been shooting at them for twenty minutes. Nothing seems to work!

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Operator, the larger entity appears to be coordinating the smaller hostiles.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: You mean it's commanding them?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Affirmative.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: You heard that? Take out the big one!

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: This is not random biological mutation.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then what is it?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Technology.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Technology? From where?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Unknown.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: You. You're the one who survived the first wave?

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Depends who's asking.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Dr. Seraphine Vale. Fracture research division.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: You study those things?

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: I studied the energy signatures before today.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Before today?

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: We've been detecting anomalies for months.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: And nobody thought to tell the public?

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: We didn't know what they were.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: That's convenient.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: There is something you need to understand. The event that destroyed this city wasn't the beginning.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Something opened the door.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: And what's on the other side?

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: That's what I'm afraid we're about to find out.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Operator, I have located an active signal beneath Nexus City.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Another survivor?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Negative.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then what?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: A research facility.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Which facility?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Sublevel Research Complex 09.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: That's impossible.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Because that facility was sealed six months ago.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: What were they researching?

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: The Fractures.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: You said nobody knew what they were.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: I said we didn't understand them.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: There's a difference.

lines.speaker: SCIENTIST
lines.text: Day 184. The signal has changed again.

lines.speaker: SCIENTIST
lines.text: We've confirmed that the energy signature is responding to human consciousness.

lines.speaker: SCIENTIST
lines.text: No... no, that's not possible.

lines.speaker: SCIENTIST
lines.text: If anyone finds this recording, listen carefully.

lines.speaker: SCIENTIST
lines.text: It knew we were coming.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Operator...

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I've found something.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I don't think we were the first civilization to encounter this.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: This is the place?

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Yes. Research Complex 09.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: You said it was shut down six months ago.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: It was supposed to be.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I've detected an active power source behind the blast door.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Can you open it?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I can attempt to access the security network.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: This facility was never connected to the public network. It had its own isolated system.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Tell me that was the ventilation system.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: It was not.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Welcome back, Dr. Vale.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: What did you just say?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I said welcome back, Dr. Vale.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: I have never accessed this terminal.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: These systems are still active. Somebody has been conducting experiments here.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Six months after the facility supposedly closed?

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Apparently.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I have detected 27 biological signatures.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Where are they?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Unclear.

lines.speaker: DR. CROSS
lines.text: If you're watching this, then the containment protocols have failed. We thought the Fracture was an opening. A doorway into another dimension. We were wrong.

lines.speaker: DR. CROSS
lines.text: It's not opening into somewhere else. Something is opening into us.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: They were trying to synchronize human biology with Fracture energy.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: To create soldiers who could survive inside a Fracture.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Warning. Biological activity increasing.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Is it dead?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Biological activity has ceased.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: I've seen this symbol before. In the original Fracture research files.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: NOVA, open it.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Access denied.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Try again.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The system has identified your biometric signature.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I've never been here.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I understand.

lines.speaker: DR. CROSS
lines.text: There are five signatures. Five points of contact between our world and something far older. We believed they were individuals. But they aren't just connected to the Fractures. They are connected to why the Fractures exist.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Five signatures...

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: You know what they are?

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: No. But I think we've been looking in the wrong direction.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Energy signature detected.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: That's not a gateway.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then what is it?

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: A receiver.

lines.speaker: UNKNOWN VOICE
lines.text: ...connection established...

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: NOVA?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: That transmission is not originating from our network.

lines.speaker: UNKNOWN VOICE
lines.text: ...we have found you...

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Shut it down!

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I'm attempting to—

lines.speaker: UNKNOWN VOICE
lines.text: ...the first has awakened...

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Warning. Structural integrity compromised.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: We need to get out!

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: The emergency elevator is on the eastern side!

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Negative. The elevator is inaccessible. Maintenance tunnel, approximately 180 metres ahead.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: How much do you know about this project?

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Not enough.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Try again.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: I knew the research existed. I didn't know what they were building.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: And you expect me to believe that?

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: No. But I need you to understand something. If that machine was communicating with something outside our reality, then the Fracture wasn't an invasion.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: What was it?

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: An invitation.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Operator, we have a problem.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: What now?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The signal we detected underground has been transmitted.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Transmitted where?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I don't know. But something has responded.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: NOVA... how many?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Multiple incoming signatures.

lines.speaker: UNKNOWN VOICE
lines.text: The first door is open.

lines.speaker: UNKNOWN FIGURE
lines.text: The first signal has been received.

lines.speaker: SECOND FIGURE
lines.text: And the vessel?

lines.speaker: UNKNOWN FIGURE
lines.text: Awakened.

lines.speaker: SECOND FIGURE
lines.text: Find the five.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: You're late.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Didn't realize I had an appointment.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: After what happened underground, you're lucky you're still breathing.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: You knew about that facility?

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: I knew it existed. I didn't know what they were doing inside.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: That's convenient.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Doctor, I suggest you choose your next words carefully.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: People died because your organization concealed information.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: People are dying right now because we don't understand what's coming through those openings.

lines.speaker: OFFICER
lines.text: Commander, General Rainer is ready.

lines.speaker: RAINER
lines.text: Twenty minutes ago, we lost communication with three military installations.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: What happened?

lines.speaker: RAINER
lines.text: They were attacked.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: By the same creatures?

lines.speaker: RAINER
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: RAINER
lines.text: These things are different.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: They use weapons. They communicate. They coordinate attacks.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: So they're soldiers.

lines.speaker: RAINER
lines.text: Exactly.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: That's not instinctive behavior.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Correct. Their movements indicate a centralized command structure.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Can we identify their leader?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Negative.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: However, this entity appears to control nearby hostiles.

lines.speaker: RAINER
lines.text: We need that thing captured or destroyed.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: And we need the eastern district secured.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: When do we leave?

lines.speaker: RAINER
lines.text: Immediately.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Listen carefully. You're not military.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Never claimed to be.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Out there, that distinction won't matter.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then why bring me?

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Because you survived something that killed trained soldiers.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: That's your entire recruitment strategy?

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: For now.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Approaching the designated combat zone.

lines.speaker: SOLDIER
lines.text: Contact! Front!

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Everyone out! Defensive formation!

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Warning. Unknown hostile approaching.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I can see that.

lines.speaker: ENEMY COMMANDER
lines.text: Identify... the awakened one.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Did you hear that?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Affirmative.

lines.speaker: ENEMY COMMANDER
lines.text: You were not meant to awaken.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Who are you?

lines.speaker: ENEMY COMMANDER
lines.text: The question is not who I am.

lines.speaker: ENEMY COMMANDER
lines.text: The question is what you have become.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Who sent you?

lines.speaker: ENEMY COMMANDER
lines.text: You still believe this is an invasion.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Isn't it?

lines.speaker: ENEMY COMMANDER
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: ENEMY COMMANDER
lines.text: It is a reclamation.

lines.speaker: ENEMY COMMANDER
lines.text: Tell the five... the covenant has been broken.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Transmission detected.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: From where?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The defeated entity.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Can you trace it?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: It originated from Earth.

lines.speaker: RAINER
lines.text: You destroyed our only opportunity to capture one alive!

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: It was trying to kill me.

lines.speaker: RAINER
lines.text: We needed intelligence!

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: General, the creature communicated with us.

lines.speaker: RAINER
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: It knew about five individuals. It mentioned something called the Covenant.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: General?

lines.speaker: RAINER
lines.text: Dismissed.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Excuse me?

lines.speaker: RAINER
lines.text: I said dismissed.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: You know something.

lines.speaker: RAINER
lines.text: You have no idea what you're involved in.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then explain it.

lines.speaker: RAINER
lines.text: Not here.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Meet me at the old transit terminal tonight.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Because I think someone inside our organization is working with them.

lines.speaker: UNKNOWN FIGURE
lines.text: The first contact has been made.

lines.speaker: SECOND FIGURE
lines.text: And the awakened one?

lines.speaker: UNKNOWN FIGURE
lines.text: Confirmed.

lines.speaker: SECOND FIGURE
lines.text: Then the prophecy was correct.

lines.speaker: UNKNOWN FIGURE
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: UNKNOWN FIGURE
lines.text: The prophecy was incomplete.

lines.speaker: SECOND FIGURE
lines.text: What is the sixth?

lines.speaker: UNKNOWN FIGURE
lines.text: A mistake.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: You said you had answers.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: I have questions. That's worse.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Six months ago, General Rainer authorized a classified operation.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Project Genesis?

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: They weren't studying the Fractures.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then what?

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: They were trying to communicate with whatever was inside them.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Because somebody promised them they could control it.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Operator. Incoming transmission.

lines.speaker: UNKNOWN VOICE
lines.text: We know you are listening.

lines.speaker: UNKNOWN VOICE
lines.text: You have awakened something that should have remained asleep.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Operator...

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I have discovered something in my own system.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: What did you find?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: An encrypted directive.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: From who?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: From someone who knew you before the Fracture.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: This contains everything I could recover from the Genesis operation.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: And General Rainer?

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: He's not going to make this easy.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I've decrypted part of the transmission. It references an individual identified as Subject Six.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: The Genesis project only documented five signatures.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then what is Subject Six?

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: That's what we're going to find out.

lines.speaker: WARD
lines.text: So this is the one.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I'm standing right here.

lines.speaker: WARD
lines.text: Good. I prefer people who speak for themselves. We've reviewed your combat recordings.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Without asking?

lines.speaker: WARD
lines.text: The world ended yesterday. Privacy regulations are having a difficult week.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Director, we need to discuss Research Complex 09.

lines.speaker: WARD
lines.text: Not here.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: That's exactly the problem. Nobody wants to discuss it anywhere.

lines.speaker: WARD
lines.text: Our priority is survival. We protect settlements, secure resources and establish safe territories.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: The Ascendancy has been collecting Fracture samples since before the disaster.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: And nobody stopped them?

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: They have facilities outside our jurisdiction.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: So humanity is already fighting itself.

lines.speaker: WARD
lines.text: Humanity has always fought itself. The Fractures simply gave us something bigger to fight over.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: You're Kael Draven?

lines.speaker: KAEL
lines.text: Depends who's asking.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Someone who keeps hearing your name.

lines.speaker: KAEL
lines.text: That's usually a bad sign.

lines.speaker: KAEL
lines.text: Everybody down there thinks they're saving the world.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: And you don't?

lines.speaker: KAEL
lines.text: I think people need saving. The world can sort itself out.

lines.speaker: KAEL
lines.text: My people operate outside military control. We rescue civilians, recover supplies and hunt anything that comes through those openings.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Sounds useful.

lines.speaker: KAEL
lines.text: It is. Until somebody decides we're criminals. If you ever get tired of taking orders, give me a call.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: These readings were recorded over several years. The sixth was deliberately removed from the official records.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Operator. I have located the encrypted directive.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: NOVA, what is this?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I cannot determine the original authorization source.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Who programmed you?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I don't know.

lines.speaker: RAINER
lines.text: Six months ago, we received a transmission.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: From whom?

lines.speaker: RAINER
lines.text: We never identified the sender. It contained information about Fracture technology, advanced energy systems and something called the Ascension Protocol.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: And you responded?

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: You opened communication with them?

lines.speaker: RAINER
lines.text: We believed we could control the situation.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: And now?

lines.speaker: RAINER
lines.text: Now I believe we made a terrible mistake.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Unauthorized access detected in the eastern security sector.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Stop right there!

lines.speaker: FRACTURE INFILTRATOR
lines.text: The sixth has been located.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Who sent you?

lines.speaker: FRACTURE INFILTRATOR
lines.text: The ones who remember.

lines.speaker: SECOND FIGURE
lines.text: The sixth has awakened.

lines.speaker: UNKNOWN FIGURE
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: SECOND FIGURE
lines.text: Then the Covenant must be restored.

lines.speaker: UNKNOWN FIGURE
lines.text: Not yet. The vessel is incomplete.

lines.speaker: SECOND FIGURE
lines.text: And the five?

lines.speaker: UNKNOWN FIGURE
lines.text: They must remember who they were.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Current population estimate: 18,420 civilians.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: How many soldiers?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Approximately 2,300 military personnel and 640 independent Operators.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: That's a lot of people depending on us.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Correct.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: You always know how to make someone feel better.

lines.speaker: COLE
lines.text: There you are. Command wants you at the northern observation tower.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: What's happening?

lines.speaker: COLE
lines.text: That's what we're trying to figure out.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: We've been tracking this for forty minutes.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: A Fracture. Not like the others.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Energy output exceeds all previously recorded events.

lines.speaker: WARD
lines.text: Can we close it?

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: I don't know.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Everyone to battle stations!

lines.speaker: WARD
lines.text: Evacuate the outer settlement!

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: We're not abandoning these people!

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: We're holding this position.

lines.speaker: SOLDIER
lines.text: THAT THING IS GOING TO BREAK THROUGH!

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Operator, we need that creature stopped!

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Working on it!

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Its outer armor is extremely resistant to conventional weapons.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Weak point?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Three energy nodes along its spinal structure.

lines.speaker: COLE
lines.text: You actually killed it.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I wouldn't recommend trying that yourself.

lines.speaker: COLE
lines.text: Trust me. I wasn't planning on it.

lines.speaker: COLE
lines.text: Get these people moving!

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Where's the evacuation transport?

lines.speaker: COLE
lines.text: Three minutes out!

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Incoming hostile force approaching from the east.

lines.speaker: COLE
lines.text: How many?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Approximately 180 signatures.

lines.speaker: COLE
lines.text: Get them out.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: We're leaving together.

lines.speaker: COLE
lines.text: That's an order.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I'm not in your military.

lines.speaker: COLE
lines.text: Then consider it a request.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Cole! Don't!

lines.speaker: COLE
lines.text: Tell them we held the line.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Captain Cole's biometric signal has been lost.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Keep the evacuation moving.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Operator, I am detecting an extremely powerful entity.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Another commander?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Negative. This signature is substantially greater.

lines.speaker: THE HARBINGER
lines.text: You have built a fortress upon stolen ground.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Who are you?

lines.speaker: THE HARBINGER
lines.text: The one who comes to reclaim what was taken.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: You're going to have to be more specific.

lines.speaker: THE HARBINGER
lines.text: You will remember.

lines.speaker: THE HARBINGER
lines.text: You still carry the mark.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: What mark?

lines.speaker: THE HARBINGER
lines.text: The mark of the first betrayal.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Operator! Your neural activity is destabilizing!

lines.speaker: THE HARBINGER
lines.text: Not yet. The five must awaken before the sixth remembers.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: We held the settlement.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Barely.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Barely is better than nothing.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Cole believed we could win this.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: He saved hundreds of people.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: He shouldn't have had to.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: This isn't an enemy insignia. It's an identification mark.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The sixth signature matches the Operator.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: What does that mean?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I don't know.

lines.speaker: GLOBAL BROADCAST
lines.text: Attention. All surviving settlements. This is an international emergency transmission. Multiple Fracture incursions have been confirmed across the planet. All remaining military organizations are ordered to establish defensive positions.

lines.speaker: UNKNOWN RULER
lines.text: Did you find the sixth?

lines.speaker: THE HARBINGER
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: UNKNOWN RULER
lines.text: And the five?

lines.speaker: THE HARBINGER
lines.text: Still scattered.

lines.speaker: UNKNOWN RULER
lines.text: Then the First War will continue. Prepare the Covenant.

lines.speaker: UNKNOWN RULER
lines.text: The old world is ending.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: We found this under three city blocks. The siege cracked the ground open.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: How far down?

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Our scanners can't find the bottom.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: That's not possible. The structure is absorbing the scan.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The material composition does not match any terrestrial alloy or known geological sample.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: So we're going underground.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: You're going underground. I'm keeping the surface secure.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: I'm coming with you.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Doctor, this isn't a research excursion.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: It's the first evidence that might explain why the enemy calls Earth stolen ground.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: She's coming.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: If your signal drops, I send a team. Don't make me regret it.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: This thing is still powered.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Correct. Its energy output is stable and predates the current Fracture event.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Look at these markings.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Can you read them?

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: No. But they repeat in groups of five.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I recorded that.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Don't display it again.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Because it matches the symbol from the Harbinger.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: This place is older than anything we've ever excavated.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: How old?

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: I can't even begin to estimate.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The structure's geometry is consistent with the energy architecture recorded at Research Complex 09.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: The lab copied this place?

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Or the lab was trying to recreate it.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: There's the sixth again.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: It isn't standing with the others.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The sixth figure is separated from the central arrangement.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Defensive constructs activating.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Are they hostile?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: That answers the question.

lines.speaker: ARCHIVE WARDEN
lines.text: Unauthorized presence.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: We're just looking around.

lines.speaker: ARCHIVE WARDEN
lines.text: The Covenant is sealed. The breach is forbidden.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: We need to know what happened here.

lines.speaker: ARCHIVE WARDEN
lines.text: Knowledge is not permission.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then give us a reason to leave.

lines.speaker: ARCHIVE WARDEN
lines.text: The marked vessel has returned.

lines.speaker: ARCHIVE WARDEN
lines.text: Sixth bearer. Your presence is a wound in the archive.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I don't know what that means.

lines.speaker: ARCHIVE WARDEN
lines.text: You were not meant to remember.

lines.speaker: ARCHIVE WARDEN
lines.text: The seal recognizes you.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: What seal?

lines.speaker: ARCHIVE RECORDING
lines.text: The Covenant was formed to preserve the passage between worlds. Five keepers maintained the balance. The world called Earth was made a sanctuary and a lock.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Earth was a lock?

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: What was it locking away?

lines.speaker: ARCHIVE RECORDING
lines.text: When the sixth returns, the broken Covenant will call its debt.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: That's all?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The archive has withheld or lost the remaining record.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: No. Someone deliberately erased it.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Translation fragment: "Aetherion... first sanctuary... bearer..."

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Aetherion. That's not in any human historical record.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: It may refer to a location, civilization or designation.

lines.speaker: UNKNOWN VOICE
lines.text: You were the promise. You became the breach.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: What did you see?

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I don't know. But it knew me.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Operator, your biometric pattern briefly matched the archive's sixth signature.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: For how long?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: 2.4 seconds.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: That's enough. We need to get this information out.

lines.speaker: ARCHIVE WARDEN
lines.text: The first seal has weakened.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: How many seals?

lines.speaker: ARCHIVE WARDEN
lines.text: Five.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Where are they?

lines.speaker: ARCHIVE WARDEN
lines.text: Scattered among the worlds. The keepers must remember.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Structural instability detected. We must leave.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: You took your time.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: We found something.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: A buried civilization. A network between worlds. Five keepers. And a sixth figure tied to the seal.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Can you prove any of it?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I have recovered a partial archive record.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: And Earth?

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: It wasn't just a place they invaded. It was part of something much older.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: These coordinates correspond to five distinct energy readings.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: The five signatures.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: And the keepers.

lines.speaker: UNKNOWN FIGURE
lines.text: The sanctuary has remembered.

lines.speaker: SECOND FIGURE
lines.text: Then the sixth will remember too.

lines.speaker: UNKNOWN FIGURE
lines.text: Not if the keepers reach them first.

lines.speaker: UNKNOWN FIGURE
lines.text: Find the first keeper.

lines.speaker: WARD
lines.text: Eleven settlements went dark overnight. Three of them asked for help. Eight of them didn't have time to.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: And the broadcast told every frightened warlord on the planet that the world is up for grabs.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Where's Rainer?

lines.speaker: WARD
lines.text: In a holding cell. Genesis was his operation. Whatever came through those doors, he signed the invitation.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: He didn't know what he was signing.

lines.speaker: WARD
lines.text: You're defending him?

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: I'm defending the truth. Those aren't always the same thing.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Director, three convoys are approaching headquarters. None of them carry Frontier Defense identification.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Who's knocking?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Kael's Free Operators from the west. And an armored column flying the Ascendancy's colours from the Spire District.

lines.speaker: WARD
lines.text: Of course. Everyone wants to see what came out of the hole.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: The data core.

lines.speaker: WARD
lines.text: The data core. Get dressed for company.

lines.speaker: CRANE
lines.text: So this is the survivor everyone keeps whispering about. You look smaller on the recordings.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: And you are?

lines.speaker: CRANE
lines.text: Lysander Crane. Prefect of the Ascendancy. We study the Fractures while the rest of you shoot at them.

lines.speaker: KAEL
lines.text: They study people too. Ask the families in the Eastern blocks who never got their relatives back.

lines.speaker: CRANE
lines.text: Volunteers, every one. Humanity doesn't survive this by hiding behind walls, Kael.

lines.speaker: WARD
lines.text: Enough. The core stays under Frontier Defense guard until we know what's on it.

lines.speaker: CRANE
lines.text: You don't have the people to read it, Director. We do.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Nobody reads it until I've stabilised the archive. Open it wrong and it erases itself.

lines.speaker: CRANE
lines.text: Dr. Vale. I wondered where you'd landed.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Somewhere you weren't.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: We found it. We decide what happens to it.

lines.speaker: CRANE
lines.text: Brave. Let's see how long brave lasts when the next wave comes and you need our shields.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Operator, the vault sublevel just lost power.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: That's not a coincidence.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Hostiles inside the perimeter. Their signatures are human, but their equipment is Fracture-grade.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Ascendancy?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Insufficient evidence. The shields they carry match the samples Prefect Crane described.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: All units to the vault! Nobody touches that core!

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Hold the door. I'll hold everything else.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The vault door was opened from inside.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Someone let them in.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: The core is gone. Tracking shows a vehicle heading for the Spire District.

lines.speaker: KAEL
lines.text: Told you. You let the wolf into the meeting and act surprised when the sheep go missing.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then let's go get our sheep back.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The convoy is eight hundred metres ahead and accelerating.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then so are we.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I would like to remind you that most of these roads are cracked.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Noted.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: They have entered the Ascendancy tower. Its shield grid is active.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Crane built that grid with stolen Genesis designs. I'd know them anywhere.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Can you get me through it?

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: I can get you through it once. Make it count.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Containment cells on every floor. Most are empty.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Most?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Some contain people. They are alive. Their neural activity resembles yours.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Crane's been making copies of me.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Not copies. Attempts.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: We're getting these people out when this is done.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I have flagged every cell. Crane is on the top floor with the core.

lines.speaker: CRANE
lines.text: You came alone. That's either courage or arrogance.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Give me the core.

lines.speaker: CRANE
lines.text: Do you know what's on it? Five names. Five keys. And a sixth that the archive tried very hard to forget.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then you know it isn't yours.

lines.speaker: CRANE
lines.text: Nothing is anyone's anymore. Meet my answer to the end of the world.

lines.speaker: CRANE
lines.text: Enough! Enough. It's yours.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Who opened the vault for you?

lines.speaker: CRANE
lines.text: Nobody opened it for me. I came for the core, yes. But someone was already inside when we arrived.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The vault logs were erased at 3:12 AM. Your team breached at 3:20.

lines.speaker: CRANE
lines.text: You see? I'm a thief, Operator. Not the only one.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Rainer's cell is empty. The guard on duty doesn't remember his own shift.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Doesn't remember?

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Memory erasure. Clean. Professional. Whoever took Rainer also opened the vault.

lines.speaker: WARD
lines.text: The Free Operators are pulling out of the joint command. The Ascendancy is denying everything. Three days into the end of the world and the alliance is already ash.

lines.speaker: KAEL
lines.text: There never was an alliance, Director. There was a broadcast and a lot of scared people standing in the same room.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I have restored part of the core. It contains a list. Five names, recorded in a script older than any human language.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: The five keepers.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: And coordinates. The first points to Eldergrove, in the Verdant Forest.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Then that's where we go. Before whoever erased that guard gets there first.

lines.speaker: CRANE
lines.text: Take my advice, Operator. When you find the first keeper, don't ask them what they remember. Ask them what they were made to forget.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Translation complete for the first five entries.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Read them.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Ilyra Sen, the Voice. Auren Thale, the Cartographer. The Echo Before Names. Vael Turog, the Severant.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: That's four.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The fifth entry is a title, not a name. The Veiled Sovereign.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Seraphine?

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: It's nothing. The word. I've seen it carved somewhere before. I can't remember where.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Each name is paired with a seal and a place. Each keeper held one fifth of the lock.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: And the sixth?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The sixth entry has no name. Only a description. The Promise.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: "You were the promise. You became the breach." That's what the voice said to you in the archive.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I know what it said.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The coordinates are approximate. If I tune three city relays to the archive frequency I can triangulate the living signatures.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Living? The keepers are alive?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Something at each coordinate is producing a heartbeat. Whether it is a person is a separate question.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Of course it is.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Triangulation complete. Five signatures. Four are stable. One is moving.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Which one?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Vael Turog's. It is not on this world in any way I can measure. It is moving toward us anyway.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: An encrypted message on a military channel. It uses the authentication code from Project Genesis.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Rainer.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: It says: "Old terminal. Come alone. Bring the machine."

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I think he means you.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I gathered.

lines.speaker: RAINER
lines.text: You came. Good. I don't have long.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Who broke you out?

lines.speaker: RAINER
lines.text: Nobody broke me out. They walked me out. Through the front gate. Nobody stopped them because nobody could see them.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Who?

lines.speaker: RAINER
lines.text: They call themselves observers. They were inside Genesis from the start. The transmission we received, the one that told us how to build the doors. It came from them.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Why let you go?

lines.speaker: RAINER
lines.text: They didn't. I ran when they started asking me about you. They don't care about the five. Not really. They care about the sixth.

lines.speaker: RAINER
lines.text: Take this. Genesis access key. Every lab we built has a door they don't know I kept.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Operator, multiple cloaked signatures. Closing.

lines.speaker: RAINER
lines.text: They followed me. Of course they did. Go!

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Their armour bends light. I can only see them when they fire.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then I'll make them fire.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: One of them dropped this. A badge. A circle broken by a single line.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Rainer?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Gone. His signal ends at the platform edge. There is no body.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: They took him again.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Or he left with them. I cannot tell which.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Fracture forming directly overhead. It is not hostile. It is... transmitting.

lines.speaker: VAEL TUROG
lines.text: So the promise walks again.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: You're the one the Harbinger serves.

lines.speaker: VAEL TUROG
lines.text: I am Vael Turog. I held the fourth seal when your world was young. I am what your choice made of me.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I don't remember any choice.

lines.speaker: VAEL TUROG
lines.text: No. You made sure of that. Ask your companion why her name is on my list.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: What is he talking about?

lines.speaker: VAEL TUROG
lines.text: The Veiled Sovereign looks well, for someone who has died so many times.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Leave her out of this.

lines.speaker: VAEL TUROG
lines.text: Everything you love is a possibility that should never have survived. The Choir will correct that. Gently. As I once tried to.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The signal is closing.

lines.speaker: VAEL TUROG
lines.text: Find the others, keeper-breaker. Wake them. It will make the ending simpler.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: So. A man who isn't on this world wants us to wake up four people who aren't really people, so he can kill them all at once.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: That's the short version.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: I hate the short version.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: If the keepers are waking anyway, we need to reach them before Turog or these observers do.

lines.speaker: KAEL
lines.text: My people know the Eldergrove trails. Rangers still run the village up there.

lines.speaker: WARD
lines.text: Frontier Defense will hold Nexus. If this city falls while you're chasing ghosts, there'll be nothing to come back to.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Seraphine. What did he mean? Your name on his list.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: I don't know. And that frightens me more than anything he said.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Before we go. There is something in the archive I have not shown anyone. A memory, sealed to the sixth signature. I believe it will only open for you.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then let's open it.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: The dais is warm. It wasn't last time.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The seal is waiting for a biometric match. Yours.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: And if this goes wrong?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Then I will pull you out. I am fairly confident I can pull you out.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Fairly.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Seventy-one percent.

lines.speaker: ARCHIVE WARDEN
lines.text: The sixth asks to remember. The archive permits one memory. Choose nothing. See everything.

lines.speaker: ILYRA SEN
lines.text: They are coming through every gate at once. The Choir has stopped negotiating.

lines.speaker: AUREN THALE
lines.text: I have mapped eleven breaches. By nightfall there will be forty.

lines.speaker: VAEL TUROG
lines.text: Then we do what the Choir asks. We close the possibilities that are failing. We save what can be saved.

lines.speaker: ILYRA SEN
lines.text: You mean we erase them.

lines.speaker: VAEL TUROG
lines.text: I mean we stop them from suffering.

lines.speaker: VEILED SOVEREIGN
lines.text: The lock was built to protect this world, Vael. Not to choose which of its futures deserve to exist.

lines.speaker: THE ECHO
lines.text: ...the world called Earth is listening... it does not know it is the lock...

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then we don't tell it. We hold the gate.

lines.speaker: VAEL TUROG
lines.text: You always say that. And every time, you are the one who decides when the gate opens.

lines.speaker: VEILED SOVEREIGN
lines.text: Because the sixth is the promise. That was the agreement.

lines.speaker: VAEL TUROG
lines.text: Agreements end.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Operator, this is a reconstruction. I cannot tell which parts are memory and which are the archive guessing.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: It feels real.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: That is what worries me.

lines.speaker: ILYRA SEN
lines.text: Keepers! To the walls!

lines.speaker: AUREN THALE
lines.text: Every map I made says this is where we lose.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then draw a new one.

lines.speaker: ILYRA SEN
lines.text: They're breaking. Hold!

lines.speaker: VAEL TUROG
lines.text: No. They're making room. For me.

lines.speaker: VAEL TUROG
lines.text: I am sorry. I truly am. Every world you save will end anyway, only slower and in more pain.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: That's not your choice to make.

lines.speaker: VAEL TUROG
lines.text: It was never yours either. Raise your weapon, promise. Let us see if you remember how this ends.

lines.speaker: VAEL TUROG
lines.text: Yes. This is how it ended. You beat me. And then you did the thing none of us could forgive.

lines.speaker: VEILED SOVEREIGN
lines.text: Don't. If you open it now, the Covenant breaks. All of it.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: If I don't, the Choir walks through and there's nothing left to protect.

lines.speaker: ILYRA SEN
lines.text: There must be another way.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: There isn't time for another way.

lines.speaker: AUREN THALE
lines.text: The map is changing. I can't see past this moment. I can't see anything past you.

lines.speaker: VEILED SOVEREIGN
lines.text: Then I won't stand here and watch you break it.

lines.speaker: ILYRA SEN
lines.text: Sovereign! Where are you going?

lines.speaker: VEILED SOVEREIGN
lines.text: To someone who can stop this from ever happening again.

lines.speaker: THE ECHO
lines.text: ...the lock turns... the sanctuary sleeps... the promise forgets...

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Operator! The memory is collapsing! I am pulling you out!

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Wait! Who did she go to? Who?

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: You stopped breathing for nine seconds.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I opened it. The gate. I broke the Covenant.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: You opened a gate. The archive does not record why the Covenant broke. It records two departures in the same moment.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: The Sovereign left. She said she was going to someone who could stop it happening again.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Did you see her face?

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: No. She wore a veil.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Of course she did.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Operator. Something else is in the archive with us.

lines.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
lines.text: You saw too much, too soon. That was never in the plan.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Who are you?

lines.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
lines.text: Someone who has watched this world end more times than you have lived. Go to Eldergrove. Wake the Voice. And when you are ready to understand what you did, I will be waiting.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The presence is gone. Seraphine, your heart rate is extremely elevated.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: I know that voice. I don't know how. But I know it.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Eldergrove. Population before the Fracture: four thousand. Current estimate: unknown.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: It's quiet.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Too quiet. There are no birds.

lines.speaker: NYX
lines.text: There are birds. They're just smarter than you. They stopped singing when the strangers came.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: And you are?

lines.speaker: NYX
lines.text: Nyx. Kael said you'd be coming and that you'd need someone who can see in a forest. He also said you talk to your machine.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I am not a machine. I am a tactical intelligence.

lines.speaker: NYX
lines.text: It talks back. Great.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: What strangers?

lines.speaker: NYX
lines.text: People you only see out of the corner of your eye. They've been in the canopy for three days, asking the trees questions.

lines.speaker: NYX
lines.text: The rangers don't like outsiders. Don't touch anything carved.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: What happens if I touch something carved?

lines.speaker: NYX
lines.text: Nobody knows. That's why you don't.

lines.speaker: ELDER MAREN
lines.text: Kael's girl brings a soldier and a ghost in a box. What does the city want with us now?

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: We're looking for someone. A woman who doesn't remember where she came from.

lines.speaker: ELDER MAREN
lines.text: Half this valley doesn't remember where it came from. The Fracture took more than roofs.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: She would have appeared without records. Possibly years ago.

lines.speaker: ELDER MAREN
lines.text: ...The singer. At the falls. She came out of the mist twenty winters back and she hasn't aged a day of them.

lines.speaker: ELDER MAREN
lines.text: When she sings, the cracks in the sky close. Small ones. The ones that would have killed us.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Can you take us to her?

lines.speaker: ELDER MAREN
lines.text: I can point. The strangers in the trees have been pointing too.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Light-bending armour. The same as at the terminal.

lines.speaker: NYX
lines.text: Told you. Corner of your eye.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Can you see them?

lines.speaker: NYX
lines.text: I can see where the leaves move wrong. Follow my shots.

lines.speaker: COLLECTOR
lines.text: ...retrieval team two, the asset is moving to the falls... the sixth is with them...

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: They know where she is.

lines.speaker: NYX
lines.text: Then we'd better get there before they do.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: There is a resonance coming from the falls. It matches the archive's first seal.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: The first keeper.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Or something wearing her signature.

lines.speaker: ILYRA SEN
lines.text: You walk loudly for someone being hunted.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: You knew we were coming?

lines.speaker: ILYRA SEN
lines.text: The water told me. It's been nervous all morning.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: We think you're in danger.

lines.speaker: ILYRA SEN
lines.text: Everyone is in danger. You're the first who came here because of it instead of in spite of it.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Her biometric signature matches the archive's first keeper. Ilyra Sen. The Voice.

lines.speaker: ILYRA SEN
lines.text: Ilyra. That's... I haven't heard that name in a very long time. How does your little light know it?

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: It's a long story.

lines.speaker: ILYRA SEN
lines.text: I know you. I don't know from where. But I know I was very angry with you once.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Operator, the forest has gone silent again.

lines.speaker: ILYRA SEN
lines.text: They're not the hunters. They're older. They follow the song.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then stop singing!

lines.speaker: ILYRA SEN
lines.text: If I stop, the crack above us opens all the way. Keep them off me.

lines.speaker: NYX
lines.text: I've got the left bank. Don't let anything cross the water.

lines.speaker: ILYRA SEN
lines.text: It's closed. For now.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Those were Null Choir constructs. Small ones. They were not here to kill her.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then what?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: They were listening. To see if she remembers.

lines.speaker: ILYRA SEN
lines.text: I woke in the mist with a song in my mouth and no name. For twenty years that was enough.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: We can't make you come with us.

lines.speaker: ILYRA SEN
lines.text: No. But you'll come back. Your kind always comes back.

lines.speaker: NYX
lines.text: "Your kind." What does that mean?

lines.speaker: ILYRA SEN
lines.text: I don't know. I only know it's true.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: There are standing stones above the shrine. They carry the same glyphs as the archive. If the first seal sleeps anywhere, it sleeps there.

lines.speaker: ILYRA SEN
lines.text: The stones hum when I pass them. I always thought it was the wind.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Show us in the morning.

lines.speaker: NYX
lines.text: Collector tracks everywhere. They came back in the night.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Did they take anything?

lines.speaker: NYX
lines.text: They didn't take. They measured.

lines.speaker: ILYRA SEN
lines.text: I used to leave flowers here. I never knew why.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Three of the stones are dormant. If they can be woken in sequence, the shrine may complete a circuit.

lines.speaker: ILYRA SEN
lines.text: And then?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: And then you may remember. Or the shrine may explode. The glyphs are ambiguous.

lines.speaker: ILYRA SEN
lines.text: I like your machine. It's honest.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Touch each stone in turn. I will tune them to Ilyra's voice.

lines.speaker: ILYRA SEN
lines.text: What do I sing?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Whatever you sang the morning you woke.

lines.speaker: ILYRA SEN
lines.text: I remember a city of white stone. A gate. Five of us. And you, standing a little apart from everyone.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: The sixth.

lines.speaker: ILYRA SEN
lines.text: The promise. Everyone loved you for it, and everyone was afraid of the day you'd have to keep it.

lines.speaker: COLLECTOR
lines.text: Asset confirmed awake. Retrieve the Voice. The sixth is expendable if necessary.

lines.speaker: NYX
lines.text: Expendable. They said you're expendable.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I heard.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Its harness is drawing power from the stones. Break the harness and it falls.

lines.speaker: COLLECTOR
lines.text: ...retrieval failed... the Second is already here...

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Another signature. It walked out of a Fracture fifty metres behind us.

lines.speaker: OREN VASQ
lines.text: Please. Lower your weapons. If I wanted anyone dead, the stones would be the only thing left standing.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Who are you?

lines.speaker: OREN VASQ
lines.text: Oren Vasq. I serve the Continuum. I speak for the one you met in the archive.

lines.speaker: ILYRA SEN
lines.text: You were there. In the sanctuary. You held the door for her when she walked away.

lines.speaker: OREN VASQ
lines.text: You remember quickly, Voice. Faster than predicted.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Her? You mean the Sovereign.

lines.speaker: OREN VASQ
lines.text: I mean that the Continuum has kept this world alive through eleven endings, and the sixth has caused nine of them.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Nine?

lines.speaker: OREN VASQ
lines.text: You don't remember those either. That is the mercy we give you every time. Come with us, Ilyra Sen. We can protect you from what's coming.

lines.speaker: ILYRA SEN
lines.text: You protected the last world by watching it burn. I remember that too.

lines.speaker: OREN VASQ
lines.text: Then we will speak again. When there are fewer of you.

lines.speaker: ILYRA SEN
lines.text: I'm ready. Stand with me.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The stones are synchronising. The first seal is responding.

lines.speaker: ILYRA SEN
lines.text: I am Ilyra Sen. Voice of the Concord. Keeper of the first seal. I was asked to sing the world asleep. I'm going to sing it awake instead.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: First seal restored. I am reading the lock on the far side of the planet shifting by a fraction of a degree.

lines.speaker: ILYRA SEN
lines.text: Listen to me. The sixth was our promise. You were meant to open the lock when this world was ready to meet what lies beyond it.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: And I opened it early.

lines.speaker: ILYRA SEN
lines.text: You opened it to save us. I've been angry with you for longer than this world has had a name. I don't think I am anymore.

lines.speaker: NYX
lines.text: I'm coming with you. Kael would never forgive me if I let you get her killed on the way out.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Glad to have you.

lines.speaker: NYX
lines.text: Don't be glad yet.

lines.speaker: ILYRA SEN
lines.text: I've never flown.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Statistically, it is very safe.

lines.speaker: ILYRA SEN
lines.text: Statistically, so was the world.

lines.speaker: ILYRA SEN
lines.text: You.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Dr. Seraphine Vale. I don't believe we've met.

lines.speaker: ILYRA SEN
lines.text: We have. You wore a veil then. And you sounded exactly as tired as you do now.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: You're mistaken.

lines.speaker: ILYRA SEN
lines.text: Perhaps. I've been mistaken about a great many things. Never about a voice.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Seraphine. Talk to me.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: There's nothing to talk about. I have a doctorate, a dead research division, and the same nightmares as everyone else.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Seraphine's genetic profile does not match any civilian database. I assumed it was classified.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: It was. By me. Can we please find the people who are actually trying to kill us?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Rainer's key opens a door that does not appear on any Frontier Defense map. Lab Three. Under the harbor.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: I ran security on Genesis for a year. There was no Lab Three.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: There is now.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Door open. Lights are on. Somebody has been working here this week.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Armed personnel. Continuum markings. They are not cloaked.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Then they're not here to hide. They're here to kill.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: They fight like special forces.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Because they were. Their records list them as dead in Frontier Defense operations over the last decade.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: ...I knew two of these men. I went to their funerals.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Their database is open. They did not expect anyone to reach it.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Observers monitor Fracture activity. Executors eliminate threats. Collectors retrieve artifacts. Researchers experiment. And above them all, the Inner Circle.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Who leads it?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The records call him only the Architect.

lines.speaker: DR. CROSS
lines.text: Log entry. Day 412. The vessel performed beyond projection. The Architect is pleased, though he would never say so.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Day 412? Cross died on Day 184. I read the report.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The report was written by Continuum Observers.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: They let the lab fall on purpose. To see what would come through.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: To see what I would do.

lines.speaker: DR. CROSS
lines.text: The sixth is not a weapon. The sixth is a variable. We cannot predict it. That is precisely why the Architect wants it near.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Something has been released from the test chamber.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Continuum?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Continuum armour. Fracture-grown body. It was built here, from someone.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: It is down. Its last transmission went to an address I can't trace.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: So they know we were here.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Good. I want them to know.

lines.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
lines.text: Every screen. Forgive the theatre. It's the only way your machine lets me speak.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: The Architect.

lines.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
lines.text: A title I chose because nobody alive remembers the name I was born with. Not even me, most days.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: You let Research Complex 09 fall.

lines.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
lines.text: I let a great many things fall. Cities. Continents. Whole worlds, once or twice. I am trying to keep the one thing that matters from falling with them.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: And what's that?

lines.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
lines.text: Continuity. A world that goes on. Yours has broken eleven times. I have rebuilt it eleven times.

lines.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
lines.text: Hello, Seraphine. You look well.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Turn it off.

lines.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
lines.text: My predictions end before your story does, sixth. Nothing else in creation does that. You should find that frightening. I certainly do.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Seraphine.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Not now. Please. Not now.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Second coordinate. Solmara Desert. Surface temperature forty-seven degrees.

lines.speaker: GOLIATH
lines.text: And climbing. Commander Voss sends his regards. And me.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: You're Goliath.

lines.speaker: GOLIATH
lines.text: I'm what Frontier Defense sends when it doesn't trust the desert. Or you. Mostly the desert.

lines.speaker: NYX
lines.text: He's bigger than Kael described.

lines.speaker: GOLIATH
lines.text: Kael always describes me sitting down.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The Ascendancy has three salvage teams digging near the old colonnade. They arrived yesterday.

lines.speaker: GOLIATH
lines.text: Crane's people. Always first to the shovel.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Sandstorm forming to the south. We have about twelve minutes.

lines.speaker: GOLIATH
lines.text: Then don't stop for anything. Including me.

lines.speaker: GOLIATH
lines.text: Dunegate. Last town before the deep desert. They've survived three Fracture storms on salt and stubbornness.

lines.speaker: NYX
lines.text: My kind of people.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: There is a story repeating in the market. A map that redraws itself.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Where do I buy one?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Nobody can. Everyone who tries says the map was sold the day before.

lines.speaker: TRADER
lines.text: The glass map? Sold yesterday. It's always sold yesterday.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: To who?

lines.speaker: TRADER
lines.text: To an old man who walks out of the dunes every spring with sand on his eyelids. He pays in drawings.

lines.speaker: TRADER
lines.text: Last spring he drew me a road that didn't exist. A week later the Fracture made it. Saved my caravan.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Where does he go?

lines.speaker: TRADER
lines.text: Down. Under the colonnade. Where the Ascendancy are digging now. If you find him, tell him he owes me a map.

lines.speaker: GOLIATH
lines.text: Shielded diggers. Crane spared no expense.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: We're not here to kill them.

lines.speaker: GOLIATH
lines.text: Tell them that.

lines.speaker: CRANE
lines.text: Operator. Again. Do you follow me, or do I follow you? It's getting hard to tell.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Call off your teams, Crane.

lines.speaker: CRANE
lines.text: Gladly. We found nothing. The entrance only opens for someone it recognises. I suspect that's you.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The door is reacting to your signature. And to Seraphine's map coordinates. Both.

lines.speaker: GOLIATH
lines.text: I don't like underground.

lines.speaker: NYX
lines.text: You don't like anything.

lines.speaker: GOLIATH
lines.text: I like outside.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: A sheet of glass. Four metres across. It is drawing.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: What is it drawing?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Us. Our positions. It drew your next step before you took it.

lines.speaker: NYX
lines.text: That's not creepy at all.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: There are other marks. Five. One in Eldergrove, glowing. One here, flickering. One beneath the sea near Verdant Forest. One in the far north. And one... outside the edge of the glass.

lines.speaker: GOLIATH
lines.text: How can a map have something outside its edge?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I don't know. The glass is still drawing it.

lines.speaker: CIPHER
lines.text: Don't touch it with your hands. It remembers fingerprints. And it judges them.

lines.speaker: GOLIATH
lines.text: Who's this?

lines.speaker: CIPHER
lines.text: Cipher. Until last week, chief cartographic researcher for the Ascendancy. Until last week, Crane's favourite.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: What happened last week?

lines.speaker: CIPHER
lines.text: I read what Crane does with the people in his cells. I left. With his best equipment.

lines.speaker: NYX
lines.text: So you're a thief.

lines.speaker: CIPHER
lines.text: I'm an ex-employee with severance. The map has been drawing my face for three days. I assumed it wanted to meet me.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I detect the same neural resonance in Cipher that I found in the tower's cells. Weaker.

lines.speaker: CIPHER
lines.text: Yes. I was one of the volunteers. Don't look at me like that. It's how I can read this thing.

lines.speaker: CIPHER
lines.text: The map needs power to show more than us. The array can give it a sunrise's worth in a minute.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: And if it overloads?

lines.speaker: CIPHER
lines.text: Then we'll have a very bright minute.

lines.speaker: CIPHER
lines.text: There. Do you see? Every line it draws bends toward one point. Not a place. A person.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Me.

lines.speaker: CIPHER
lines.text: No. Him.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: A figure is walking out of the dunes. The map drew him an hour ago.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: A Fracture storm. It's following the walking figure.

lines.speaker: GOLIATH
lines.text: Everybody behind me. I'm the widest thing here.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The storm has passed through him. He is unharmed.

lines.speaker: NYX
lines.text: Of course he is.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: He has stopped beneath the bones of something very large.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Ribcage. Of what?

lines.speaker: CIPHER
lines.text: Nobody knows. It was here before the desert.

lines.speaker: AUREN THALE
lines.text: You're late. The map said noon.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: We got held up by a storm.

lines.speaker: AUREN THALE
lines.text: The map said that too. I drew you this morning. You looked taller.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Biometric match. Auren Thale. The Cartographer. Second keeper.

lines.speaker: AUREN THALE
lines.text: Thale. Hm. That's what the first map was signed with. I always thought it was the name of a road.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Do you know who you are?

lines.speaker: AUREN THALE
lines.text: I know where I am. That's usually more useful.

lines.speaker: AUREN THALE
lines.text: I mapped every road out of the end of the world, young one. Every one of them goes through you.

lines.speaker: AUREN THALE
lines.text: Forty years I've walked this desert. Drawing roads that don't exist yet. They always arrive.

lines.speaker: CIPHER
lines.text: You're not predicting the future. You're surveying it.

lines.speaker: AUREN THALE
lines.text: Clever. The Ascendancy taught you well, before you robbed them.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: The Continuum says I ended this world nine times.

lines.speaker: AUREN THALE
lines.text: Then they've been reading the wrong map. I've seen your roads. Nine of them end. Two don't. The two that don't, nobody can see past.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The Architect said the same thing. His predictions end before the operator's story does.

lines.speaker: AUREN THALE
lines.text: Of course they do. He maps with walls. I map with roads. You can't wall in a road you haven't walked yet.

lines.speaker: AUREN THALE
lines.text: Before we go further, you should see these. The road to the seal passes the old roost.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Murals. Astryan-era pigment. Dragons... standing beside people.

lines.speaker: CIPHER
lines.text: Allies. Not mounts. Look at the eyes. They're drawn as equals.

lines.speaker: AUREN THALE
lines.text: The dragons kept a covenant of their own. Older than ours, in some ways. The Ashen line still remembers it.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Should we be worried?

lines.speaker: AUREN THALE
lines.text: We should be polite. The roost is not our business today. Its keeper settles its own debts, with whoever it chooses.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: One figure is painted apart from the others. Watching. The pigment around it has been scraped away and repainted many times.

lines.speaker: AUREN THALE
lines.text: The Witness. Even the dragons couldn't decide whether to remember it.

lines.speaker: AUREN THALE
lines.text: Step where I step. The ground here is in two minds about being ground.

lines.speaker: GOLIATH
lines.text: I hate this desert.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Null Choir constructs. They suppress sound. I can barely hear you.

lines.speaker: NYX
lines.text: Then stop talking and shoot.

lines.speaker: AUREN THALE
lines.text: Choir. They come when a keeper starts remembering. Like moths to a lamp.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Or wolves to a fire.

lines.speaker: AUREN THALE
lines.text: Wolves are honest about it.

lines.speaker: AUREN THALE
lines.text: Sit. I want to tell you something before the seal wakes up and I start being somebody important.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Go on.

lines.speaker: AUREN THALE
lines.text: A long time ago, you asked me to map a world where you didn't have to choose. Where the gate could stay closed and nobody had to suffer behind it.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Did you?

lines.speaker: AUREN THALE
lines.text: I tried. For a hundred years. I never finished it. Every map I drew, there was one road where you had to open the gate. Every map.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: So I was always going to do it.

lines.speaker: AUREN THALE
lines.text: No. You were always going to have to decide. That's not the same, and the difference is the only thing I've ever been sure of.

lines.speaker: CIPHER
lines.text: The map is moving again. Something big is heading toward Dunegate.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I recognise the signature. The Harbinger.

lines.speaker: GOLIATH
lines.text: The thing from Haven-01? The one you didn't finish?

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: It left before I could.

lines.speaker: AUREN THALE
lines.text: It's coming for me. The Severant can't stand a keeper who knows where they're going.

lines.speaker: NYX
lines.text: Then we get to Dunegate first.

lines.speaker: TRADER
lines.text: You brought a war to my market.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: It was coming anyway. We brought help.

lines.speaker: GOLIATH
lines.text: Everybody who can carry a rifle, on the walls. Everybody who can't, in the salt cellars.

lines.speaker: AUREN THALE
lines.text: The map shows them coming from three directions. Then four. Then it stops drawing.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Why would it stop drawing?

lines.speaker: AUREN THALE
lines.text: Because after that, it depends on us.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Contact. All directions.

lines.speaker: GOLIATH
lines.text: Make them pay for every metre of sand!

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The attack is pulling back. Something is clearing a path for itself.

lines.speaker: THE HARBINGER
lines.text: Sixth. You built another fortress on stolen ground.

lines.speaker: THE HARBINGER
lines.text: We met at Haven. You remember me now?

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I remember you ran.

lines.speaker: THE HARBINGER
lines.text: I was told to wait. The five had to wake before the sixth remembered. Two are awake. That is enough.

lines.speaker: THE HARBINGER
lines.text: It does not matter. I was only ever the voice before the voice.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Whose voice?

lines.speaker: THE HARBINGER
lines.text: I was a herald once. For the keepers. For you. Before you broke what we served.

lines.speaker: THE HARBINGER
lines.text: Vael... I have failed. Again.

lines.speaker: VAEL TUROG
lines.text: You did not fail, old friend. You counted them for me. Two awake. Three asleep. The sixth beginning to remember.

lines.speaker: THE HARBINGER
lines.text: Then let me rest.

lines.speaker: VAEL TUROG
lines.text: Rest. I will finish this kindly.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The Harbinger's signal is gone. It was not killed. It was released.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: He was a herald for the keepers. For me.

lines.speaker: AUREN THALE
lines.text: He was. His name was Ossian. He used to carry your letters.

lines.speaker: AUREN THALE
lines.text: My turn, I suppose.

lines.speaker: CIPHER
lines.text: What do you need?

lines.speaker: AUREN THALE
lines.text: Nothing. A cartographer only needs to know where he's standing.

lines.speaker: AUREN THALE
lines.text: I am Auren Thale. First Cartographer. Keeper of the second seal. I have mapped the end of the world. I'm going to need a bigger map.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Second seal restored. The glass map has stopped drawing us. It is drawing a route to the sea.

lines.speaker: AUREN THALE
lines.text: The third keeper doesn't have a body anymore. Only a voice, underwater, saying the same thing over and over.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: What's it saying?

lines.speaker: AUREN THALE
lines.text: Your name. The one you had before this one.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Two seals restored. Three remain. Chapter of record closed.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Her bunk hasn't been slept in. Her research is wiped. She took a transport at four in the morning and logged it as a supply run.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Where to?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Neon City. The transport was found empty at the harbour an hour ago.

lines.speaker: ILYRA SEN
lines.text: She's going home.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Neon City isn't her home.

lines.speaker: ILYRA SEN
lines.text: Not the city. Whatever she left there. People always go back for what they hid before they knew why they hid it.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: If she's selling us out —

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: She isn't.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: You don't know that.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: No. But I'm going to find out before you do.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Neon City. Population twelve million. Number of people who will help us for free: statistically, zero.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then we'll pay.

lines.speaker: VESPER
lines.text: The famous survivor. In my little room. Should I be flattered or should I be running?

lines.speaker: PLAYER
